controlling_proposition: Clubotel La Dorada, S.L. / ONA was not merely an unrelated third-party bidder. Its proposed operating and acquisition role formed part of a coordinated funded-exit architecture directed at determining the properly payable insolvency amount, funding payment or consignation to recognised creditors, concluding Concurso 36/2012 and restoring professional unitary hotel operation.

source_classes.proposition: ONA letter of intent, business plan and expansion material existed before 7 June 2018.
Carlos Sanz sought offer terms, the amount to improve and timing from the Insolvency Administrator; the AC declined substantive disclosure and directed formal personacion/court application.
source_classes.limit: The AC answered; the supported criticism concerns substance and effect, not literal silence.

source_classes.proposition: Clubotel/ONA hotel-industry lease and suspensive annex were signed.
source_classes.limit: Operation remained conditional; ONA was not the exit lender.

source_classes.proposition: The project side alleges a material-control takeover impaired access, operation, information, income and security assumptions.
Stoneweg/Varia conditional binding-offer route was issued and Daniel Irigoyen contemporaneously reported presenting an integrated funded exit to the judge and AC.
source_classes.limit: The professional account is not certified judicial minutes.

source_classes.proposition: Carlos Sanz, Daniel Irigoyen, Cuatrecasas, Juan Tomas Parrilla and the project side coordinated debt certification and an exit by payment or consignation to all creditors; ONA was within the strategy although omitted from one draft.
source_classes.limit: No final drawdown or satisfaction of every condition is established.

source_classes.proposition: Clubotel La Dorada, represented by Daniel Irigoyen, sought personacion, challenged refusal and appeared in the docket as an interested party.
source_classes.limit: The formal pleaded interest was acquisition/access to information; the wider funded-exit purpose comes from the combined record.

source_classes.proposition: The Insolvency Administration opposed or challenged Clubotel's personacion.
source_classes.limit: The complete pleading and ruling control exact grounds and outcome.

source_classes.proposition: ONA novation work, proposed bank guarantee and Article 176 conclusion workstream continued.
